cases.observation: one successful episode with support present
cases.supports: conditional episode performance + evidence for supported joint/situated capability

cases.observation: same actor succeeds repeatedly under same narrow support
cases.supports: more stable conditional capability under that support

cases.observation: support removed; actor reconstructs and succeeds
novel tool/environment; actor transfers mechanism successfully

cases.doesNotSupport: AI caused durable deskilling outside tested horizon
cases.observation: assisted output improves while later unassisted performance falls
current performance falls under fatigue/path outage then returns without relearning
new environment raises current output but no later comparable-condition test
later comparable-condition performance improves after exposure
two actors differ in output under nonstandardized environments
seeded error is detected and corrected despite high-level support
high output depends on employer-internal systems/title/relationships

cases.doesNotSupport: forcing a fictitious independent-capability verdict; correct answer may be UNKNOWN
cases.observation: no support-removal or transfer probe is ethically/operationally justified
cases.supports: conditional capability claim may remain useful

claimBoundary: Capability is a scoped evidence-backed claim, not a directly observed scalar latent trait. Matrix distinguishes what observations support and what they do not support.

result.identificationRule: Performance evidence supports only the boundary/conditions actually tested. Stronger retained-actor claims require evidence that removes or varies the support relation relevant to the claim, when doing so is decision-relevant and admissible.
rejected: support removal as mandatory universal test
result.unknownRule: When production and expression cannot be distinguished by available evidence, preserve UNKNOWN rather than infer intrinsic gain/loss.
result.unmasking: DERIVED: stable retained-state evidence + changed current exercisability/expression; no new state primitive earned.
